blocks.text: Sulfur aam taur par doosre sulfur atoms ke saath double bond ke bajaye single bonds banata hai, kyun ke is ke orbitals ka overlap (aapas mein chadhna) kamzor hota hai. Is liye sulfur atoms aapas mein jur kar bare molecules aur zanjeerein (chains) banate hain; is amal ko catenation kehte hain. S₈ taaj (crown) jaisa molecule hai (Figure 12.7).

blocks.alt: Aath S atoms single bonds se ek band, tedhe-medhe (puckered) halqe mein jure hain jo taaj (crown) jaisa dikhta hai: oopar paanch S atoms ki zigzag qatar aur neeche teen S atoms ki qatar, aur oopar wali qatar ke dono sire neeche wali qatar se jure hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.7: Cyclo-octasulfur, (S8) taaj-numa molecule (kitab ki Figure 12.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Aath peele sulfur atoms aik aise ring mein single S-S bonds se jure hain jo chapta nahi: atoms bari bari oopar neeche hain, chaar oopar ki teh mein aur chaar neeche ki, is liye molecule taaj (crown) jaisa lagta hai. Halki surmai rings dono tehon ko dikhati hain.
blocks.caption: Cyclo-octasulfur, S8 taaj-numa (crown) molecule (Figure 12.7 ke mutabiq asal 3D model; ghuma kar har taraf se dekhein).
blocks.long_description: Sulfur double bonds ke bajaye S-S single bonds pasand karta hai kyunke us ke orbitals pehlu ba pehlu (sideways) achha overlap nahi karte, is liye woh rings aur zanjeerein banata hai (catenation). S8 mein har sulfur do doosre sulfur se juda hai aur S-S-S zaviya taqreeban 108 degree hai; yeh zaviya aath atoms ke chapte ring mein nahi samata, is liye ring mud kar taaj ki shakal le leta hai.

fallback.text: S8: aath sulfur atoms S-S single bonds ke mure hue ring mein, bari bari oopar neeche, taaj ki shakal mein.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki shakal 2D hai: aath S atoms ek halqa banate hain aur har S do doosre S atoms se single bond se jura hai. Halqa chapta nahi; atoms bari bari oopar aur neeche hain, is liye yeh taaj jaisa lagta hai. Neeche wala 3D model ghuma kar yahi oopar-neeche ki tarteeb dekhi ja sakti hai (model ka 108 darje ka zaviya hamara izafa hai, kitab mein nahi).

blocks.prompt: Kamre ke temperature par sulfur kam reactive kyun hai (exercise Q.2g)?
blocks.explanation: Sulfur mazboot S–S single bonds se jure S₈ ke taaj-numa rings ki shakal mein hota hai. 3p orbitals ka side-ways overlap kamzor hai, is liye woh reactive double bonds nahi banata. Ring torne ke liye energy chahiye, is liye sulfur zyada tar garam karne par hi react karta hai, jaise jal kar SO₂ banana.

items: Sulfur S–S single bonds banata hai (orbitals ka kamzor overlap), is liye catenation se rings aur zanjeerein.
